title: Initial Build Offer · Big Balder Brand ↔ Corgi Loaf Baking Co.

analysis.executiveSummary: Big Balder Brand seeks to strengthen its quarterback group by targeting surging Saints starting quarterback Tyler Shough from Corgi Loaf Baking Co. In a 16-team dynasty league, securing a younger, high-performing starting quarterback behind Jayden Daniels provides crucial insurance and long-term dynasty stability. To acquire Shough without weakening Corgi Loaf's current championship contention, Big Balder Brand can send veteran quarterback Baker Mayfield—preserving Corgi Loaf's 2026 backup quarterback coverage—along with a 2028 2nd-round pick. This offer aligns with both franchises' goals, providing Corgi Loaf with liquid capital and zero net loss in 2026 starting/depth value while upgrading Big Balder Brand's long-term quarterback room.

submitted.summary: The proposed construction exchanges 31-year-old Baker Mayfield and a 2028 2nd-round pick for 26-year-old Tyler Shough. Big Balder Brand secures five years of youth and rising starter upside at QB2 behind Jayden Daniels. Corgi Loaf Baking Co. maintains its 2026 QB depth behind Patrick Mahomes (Mayfield's 56.4 C-AVI slightly exceeds Shough's 54.8 C-AVI) while pocketing a 2028 2nd-round pick for future flexibility.

recommended.summary: This offer represents a win-win structure for both organizations in a 16-team format. Big Balder Brand pays a modest draft capital premium to reset QB2 age, while Corgi Loaf protects its championship window without losing backup QB quality.

overall.summary: Big Balder Brand improves its long-term QB room stability and youth without sacrificing current starting lineup quality.

officialAviAnalysis.sideAChampionshipImpact: Neutral for starting 8 slots; improves QB injury resilience with Shough's high passing volume.
officialAviAnalysis.sideADynastyImpact: Positive (+20). Replaces 31-year-old Mayfield with 26-year-old Shough, locking in a young NFL starter.
officialAviAnalysis.sideARosterImpact: Upgrades QB2 age profile from 31.0 to 26.0 while expending a 2028 2nd-round draft pick.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBChampionshipImpact: Neutral to slightly positive. Mayfield's 56.4 C-AVI provides dependable depth behind Mahomes.
officialAviAnalysis.sideBDynastyImpact: Slightly negative on player age (-5), compensated by adding a 2028 2nd-round draft pick (48.5 D-AVI).
officialAviAnalysis.sideBRosterImpact: Preserves QB depth requirement while adding liquid future capital.
officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: Side A sends 104.9 total C-AVI / 121.6 total D-AVI (Mayfield + 2028 2nd) for Side B's 54.8 C-AVI / 70.7 D-AVI (Shough). The premium paid by Big Balder Brand reflects Shough's 5-year age advantage and surging market value in 16-team 1QB formats.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Tyler Shough's market value has surged through Week 2 of the 2026 season. Operating Kellen Moore's Saints offense, Shough has thrown for over 660 yards and 4 touchdowns in two games, establishing himself as a legitimate NFL starting QB.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: Public market rates Shough as a fast-rising asset (65.0 public market). AVI maintains a disciplined 54.8 C-AVI / 70.7 D-AVI valuation, recognizing his strong early start while accounting for sample size in redraft/dynasty projections.
relevantContext: Tyler Shough is fully healthy and starting for New Orleans in 2026.
662 passing yards through 2 games is the highest 2-game total for a Saints QB since Drew Brees in 2009.
In 16-team 1QB leagues, secure starting QBs carry substantial trade value even on the bench.

frontOfficeAnalysis.opposingGmMotivation: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (Elite Contender) needs to maintain QB depth behind Patrick Mahomes while accumulating draft capital for future moves.
frontOfficeAnalysis.packageFit: Baker Mayfield satisfies Corgi Loaf's need for a reliable QB2, while the 2028 2nd pick provides net value for trading a younger asset.
frontOfficeAnalysis.lineupReplacement: Mayfield immediately replaces Shough as Corgi Loaf's QB2 behind Patrick Mahomes with zero downgrade in 2026 projection.
frontOfficeAnalysis.competitiveWindowFit: Both franchises are contending; the deal maintains 2026 roster strength for both sides.
frontOfficeAnalysis.positionalScarcity: Quarterback availability is tight in a 16-team league; exchanging QBs ensures neither side is left vulnerable to injury.

marketReality.explanation: Because Corgi Loaf receives a direct QB replacement in Baker Mayfield along with a 2028 2nd-round pick, the offer solves Corgi Loaf's backup QB requirement while rewarding them for Shough's market rise. Acceptance probability is estimated at 78%.

verdict.rationale: Big Balder Brand should propose Baker Mayfield and a 2028 2nd-round pick for Tyler Shough. The deal upgrades QB2 age from 31 to 26 without altering current starting lineup scores or leaving Corgi Loaf short at quarterback.

recommendedOffer.whyUserShouldDoIt: You acquire a 26-year-old rising NFL starting quarterback in Kellen Moore's high-volume offense to pair with Jayden Daniels, securing your QB position for years to come at the cost of a future 2nd-round pick.
recommendedOffer.whyOpponentMightAccept: Corgi Loaf maintains immediate 2026 QB depth with Baker Mayfield behind Patrick Mahomes while capturing a 2028 2nd-round pick to build future championship flexibility.

alternateOffer.rationale: If Corgi Loaf prefers immediate wide receiver depth over draft capital, sending Khalil Shakir alongside Mayfield provides Corgi Loaf with usable WR bench depth.
